Keep each fragment short so the joined row fits a narrow card.

tui.hub_links.confirm.lead.note: Public-egress consent, a destructive/irreversible publication decision. The lead is a question; confirm.keys names BOTH keys (confirm = ctrl+y, a control key so typed-ahead text can never press it; cancel = esc, which cancels only the prompt). Wrap, never truncate; the block's line count is counted into the card height so nothing is clipped.

tui.hub_links.hint.cancel.note: The bare key name ('esc'); the surrounding sentence supplies the verb ('... to cancel'). Do not repeat the verb here.

tui.hub_links.hint.select.note: Key-hint fragment for the Hub links overlay: a key and what it does, joined by ' · '. '↑↓ select' appears whenever there is more than one link. Keep each fragment short so the joined row fits a narrow card.

tui.hub_links.refusal.ineligible.note: A refusal shown on the card. {reason} is a humanized service eligibility code (hyphens -> spaces), never a raw code and never a link id. Resolve_first is the legacy/unresolved-link case.

tui.hub_links.refusal.resolve_first.note: A refusal shown on the card. {reason} is a humanized service eligibility code (hyphens -> spaces), never a raw code and never a link id. Resolve_first is the legacy/unresolved-link case.

tui.hub_links.refusal.revision_moved.note: Shown when the armed consent's policy revision differs from the row at confirm time; the user is confirming a value they never saw, so nothing is written.

tui.hub_links.hint.failed.note: Status fragment in the dim key-hint row when the selected link's last check failed; {reason} is a short lower-case phrase (e.g. `provider error`). Keep it compact: whole segments of this row drop to fit, and this one drops last among the hints.

tui.hub_links.reason.baseline_unknown.note: Refusal sentence for enabling Auto-push (U4). One complete sentence naming the situation and the next step; no developer codes.

tui.hub_links.reason.mixed_lineage.note: Refusal sentence for enabling Auto-push (U4): the local copy mixes sources. Sentence plus next step; no developer codes.

tui.hub_links.reason.no_receipt.note: Refusal sentence for enabling Auto-push (U4): no agreed starting point exists yet. Names the next step (pull or publish once). No developer codes.

tui.hub_links.reason.unsafe_publication.note: Refusal sentence for enabling Auto-push (U4): public scope needs the deliberate consent first. The interactive TUI usually shows the consent prompt instead; this copy is the fallback.

tui.hub_links.reason.unsupported_precond.note: Refusal sentence for enabling Auto-push (U4): the hub server has not positively attested atomic revision support. Complete sentence, no developer codes.
